title: Flatten Match Scores
instructions:
Complete the `flattenScores` function. It takes a `List<List<Int>>` where each inner list contains scores from one match.

Return a single `List<Int>` containing all the scores combined.

For example, `flattenScores(listOf(listOf(45, 72), listOf(91, 55)))` should return `[45, 72, 91, 55]`.
hint: Use the `.flatten()` method on the outer list to combine all inner lists into one.
